UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA

ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
v. Case No. 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD
The Honorable Judge

Rossie D. Alston Jr.

KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,

Defendants.

ORDER

This matter comes before the Court on Plaintiff's Motion for Leave to File Second
Amended and Supplemental Complaint Pursuant to Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 15(a)(2) and
15(d), and Request for Expedited Determination on the Papers (the “Motion”). Having considered
the Motion, the Memorandum in Support, the proposed Second Amended and Supplemental
Complaint attached to the Motion as Exhibit A, the Declaration of Marvelle J. Ballentine attached
as Exhibit B, and the briefing, and finding that leave should be freely given under Rule 15(a)(2) and
that supplementation is appropriate under Rule 15(d), it is hereby

ORDERED that the Motion is GRANTED; and it is further

ORDERED that the Second Amended and Supplemental Complaint attached to the Motion
as Exhibit A is DEEMED FILED as of the date of this Order and is the operative complaint in this

action; and it is further

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD Document59-3 Filed 09/08/26 Page 2 of 2 PagelD#
564

ORDERED that the Clerk may, to the extent administratively necessary, docket the Second
Amended and Supplemental Complaint separately as the operative pleading; and it is further

ORDERED that Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Supplemental Complaint Pursuant to
Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 15(d) (ECF No. 26) is DENIED AS MOOT, the supplemental
matter proposed therein having been incorporated into the Second Amended and Supplemental
Complaint; and it is further

ORDERED that Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Sur-Reply (ECF No. 43) is DENIED
AS MOOT, the Second Amended and Supplemental Complaint having replaced the First Amended
Complaint to which the briefing underlying that request was directed; and it is further

ORDERED that Defendants shall respond to the Second Amended and Supplemental
Complaint within the time prescribed by the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure or such other time as
the Court directs.

It is SO ORDERED.

Alexandria, Virginia

Date: , 2026

Ivan D. Davis
United States Magistrate Judge
